listings.caption: This code applies softmax to the last-token outputs, takes the argmax of the resulting two-class probabilities, and prints the predicted class label.
listings.code:
probas = torch.softmax(outputs[:, -1, :], dim=-1)
label = torch.argmax(probas)
print("Class label:", label.item())
listings.reason: The code takes the last-token outputs (outputs[:, -1, :]), applies softmax over the class dimension to get probabilities, then uses argmax to select the predicted class and prints it. This directly demonstrates the section’s described procedure, and the caption accurately describes what the code does (aside from not explicitly showing that it’s two-class, which is implied by the section context).
